changelog: Trailer previews rebuilt for instant, reliable playback. Trailers now have an explicit lifecycle with a queryable status instead of the app guessing from repeated 404s. A single priority queue with a small bounded worker pool produces them highest-priority-first and can no longer swamp the server with parallel yt-dlp/ffmpeg jobs. Warming is now predictive - Continue Watching, what you've recently focused and played, your interest history, popularity and time of day - rather than just top-rated titles. A new cache manager keeps disk usage bounded (evicts least-used, pins frequently-viewed, expires stale, verifies files). Adds priority-aware prefetch, a smarter preview start offset, and a /Trailer/Diagnostics endpoint. Backward compatible; adds additive trailer-state tables (schema v9/v10).
